download_vocab_alpha1e1: download the vocab_alpha1e1 vocabulary model for the 90M parameter Blender dialogue unlikelihood model to a given datapath
run_download: run the download function to fetch the vocab_alpha1e1 model archive to the specified data directory
build_vocab_model: build and download the vocab_alpha1e1_v1.tgz model archive using the dialogue_unlikelihood build module
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches the vocab_alpha1e1 model for the Blender dialogue unlikelihood project
summarize_module: summarize the vocab_alpha1e1 module which provides a download entry point for the 90M parameter Blender model vocabulary
